d: Responsible for managing, organizing, maintaining and retrieving physical and electronic project records and documentation. Ensures proper archiving, classification, preservation and document control in line with company procedures, contractual requirements and records retention policies.
q: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Management, Records Management, Library Science or a related discipline
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in archiving, records management or document control, preferably within construction or engineering
Knowledge of EDMS platforms such as Aconex and SharePoint
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to manage large volumes of documentation
r: li
Develop and maintain physical and electronic archiving systems
li
Classify, index, catalogue and store project documentation
li
Maintain archive registers and document tracking records
li
Scan, digitalize and upload documents into EDMS platforms
li
Archive construction drawings, As-Built drawings, contracts, RFIs, NCRs, ITPs, quality records and project correspondence
li
Ensure document confidentiality, security and version control
li
Support internal and external audits by retrieving archived records
li
Manage document retention and disposal in accordance with approved policies
li
Prepare archive status and document inventory reports
li
Identify opportunities to improve archiving and records management processes
